 WESTERN S.D. AND NORTHEASTERN WYO. — We are seeing some freezing temperatures this morning. Overall, though, we have temperatures ranging from the mid-30s to mid-40s right now.
 Winds are mostly light and variable, but we have a slight breeze towards Wyoming, with gusts up to 25 mph. That remains throughout today, as we are seeing southeasterly winds of 5-15 mph possible, with occasionally gusty winds up to 25 mph for areas in Wyoming and north of I-90 in South Dakota.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 NewsCenter1 
 We are expecting sunny skies today with highs mostly in the low to mid-60s. There can be upper 50s in areas like the Black Hills and scattered around western SD, while in Sheridan, WY, you can see low 70s this afternoon.
 NewsCenter1 
 Tonight, we’ll continue the trend of the mid-30s to mid-40s range. Mostly clear skies tonight with gusts up to 25 mph at times.
 Luckily by tomorrow, we should expect our winds to slow down, and we’ll have light southerly winds for our Tuesday. Highs reach back into the 70s, with again plenty of sunshine for the region.
 NewsCenter1 
 Overall, today through Wednesday we should expect calm conditions (with occasional gusts), sunny skies, and mild temperatures.
 NewsCenter1 
 It’s not until Thursday that things start to change. We should expect breezy winds to round out the week, with a slight chance of showers on Friday. Our temperatures remain mostly in the mid-60s to mid-70s though. However, by Saturday and Sunday is when we should expect our fall-like temperatures to take the reins once more. So, 50s are likely by this weekend.
 NewsCenter1 
 While we might not have stronger gusts until Thursday, I do want to point out that we are still in a drought for the region. And because we are expecting above-average temperatures and dry conditions, elevated fire concerns are a possibility. So be careful, but have a great week ahead!
